name: Alejandro Vargas
bio:
Alejandro's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Bogotá, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He began his career as a junior mechanic for a local racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for problem-solving and strategic thinking. His knack for identifying and nurturing talent led him to roles in driver development and team management, working his way up the ranks. Alejandro believes in fostering a collaborative environment where data analysis and gut instinct converge to make decisive calls on the track. Known for his meticulous planning and ability to remain composed under pressure, he aims to bring a data-driven yet human touch to Tickford Racing.

Before joining Tickford, Alejandro spent several years with a European GT team, where he honed his skills in race strategy and team coordination. He is known for his innovative approaches to pit stop optimization and his ability to motivate his team to perform at their best, even in challenging circumstances. Alejandro's experience in various motorsport disciplines, combined with his unwavering dedication, makes him a valuable asset to any racing organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Alejandro has a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of pacing when under pressure, often muttering to himself.
Insists on starting every race day with a cup of strong Colombian coffee.
